_about: Public-domain James Cardinal Gibbons (1834-1921, Archbishop of Baltimore) for the Word Hoard: 6 volumes from Internet Archive scans: The Faith of Our Fathers (tenth revised edition, 1879), Our Christian Heritage (1889), The Ambassador of Christ (1896), Discourses and Sermons (1908) and A Retrospect of Fifty Years (2 vols, 1916). Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
